# Oakline Furniture — LLM Plain Text Knowledge Catalogue

> Solid-wood beds, chairs, tables and sofas made in small batches in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Twelve pieces, built to order.

## Store Details
- **Name:** Oakline Furniture
- **Location:** 418 Wealthy Street SE, Grand Rapids, MI 49503
- **Hours:** Tuesday–Saturday, 10am–6pm
- **Phone:** +1 (616) 555-0142
- **Email:** shop@oaklinefurniture.example
- **Craftspeople:** Dana (milling & joining) and Peter (finishing & delivery)
- **Materials:** Hardwood (solid white oak, walnut, maple, cherry, ash) purchased within 200 miles of the shop. Mechanical joinery (mortise, tenon, dovetail).
- **Warranty & Repair:** Repairs on Oakline pieces are free for the first 10 years.
- **Delivery Policy:** Free delivery and assembly within 90 miles. Flat-rate $180 crating anywhere else in the lower 48 US states.

---

## Catalogue (12 Items Across 4 Categories)

### Beds (Slatted platforms in maple, oak and ash — no box spring needed)

1. **Harbor Bed Frame**
   - **Price:** $2,150
   - **Availability:** In stock
   - **Specs:** Solid maple, Queen or king, 13-in clearance
   - **Description:** A slatted maple platform with a gently angled headboard. Assembles with six bolts and no box spring.
   - **URL:** https://oaklinefurniture.example/product/harbor-bed-frame

2. **Alcove Daybed**
   - **Price:** $1,680
   - **Availability:** In stock
   - **Specs:** Solid white oak, Twin mattress, 78 × 40 × 30 in
   - **Description:** An oak twin frame with a low back on three sides, so it reads as seating until a guest needs it.
   - **URL:** https://oaklinefurniture.example/product/alcove-daybed

3. **Wick Bunk Bed**
   - **Price:** $1,940
   - **Availability:** Made to order · 5 weeks
   - **Specs:** Solid ash, Two twins, Splits in two
   - **Description:** Two ash twins on a bolted frame with an integrated ladder. Splits into a pair of standalone beds later.
   - **URL:** https://oaklinefurniture.example/product/wick-bunk-bed

### Chairs (Sold singly, so a set can be built one chair at a time)

4. **Mill Lounge Chair**
   - **Price:** $1,140
   - **Availability:** In stock
   - **Specs:** Ash and wool bouclé, 29 × 32 × 28 in, Cover washable
   - **Description:** Low ash frame with a webbed seat and a removable oat bouclé cushion. Comfortable for an hour of reading.
   - **URL:** https://oaklinefurniture.example/product/mill-lounge-chair

5. **Bramble Dining Chair**
   - **Price:** $420
   - **Availability:** In stock
   - **Specs:** Steam-bent beech, 18 × 20 × 32 in, 11 lb
   - **Description:** Steam-bent beech back, paper-cord seat, clay-washed finish. Light enough to lift with one hand.
   - **URL:** https://oaklinefurniture.example/product/bramble-dining-chair

6. **Sable Task Chair**
   - **Price:** $680
   - **Availability:** In stock
   - **Specs:** Walnut and leather, 20 × 21 × 34 in, Swivel base
   - **Description:** A walnut desk chair with a saddle-leather sling that softens with use. Swivels; does not roll.
   - **URL:** https://oaklinefurniture.example/product/sable-task-chair
